subject: C2 Kimi K2.6 smoke passes; baseline blocked on Modal billing
body: Nathan ran the pilot from his laptop. Smoke on Kimi K2.6 via Tinker passed: 5/5 answered with raw reasoning, $0.19 Tinker (results/smoke/c2_target_2026-11-14.json, ffd8940). Fixes in your C2 files, at Nathan's request: (1) tinker_proxy returns a reply cut off before </think> as reasoning_content with finish_reason length; it used to leak the half thought as content, so every A2 probe was unparseable. (2) Proxy default max_tokens 4096 -> 16384, because Petri sends none and K2.6 can think past 4096 per turn. (3) c2_pilot.sh sets OPENAI_COMPAT_PLAIN_THINKING=headroom on Kimi. (4) SSL_CERT_FILE fallback for python.org Python on macOS. (5) Deploy failures now print Modal's own error (42366b0). The baseline stopped at the auditor deploy: 'Please add a payment method to use H100 GPU functions' on Modal workspace nqiu07. No GPU time was used.
